backend/main.mo: Motoko canister implementing user profiles, access control, food entries, and health metric calculations with authorization checks.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping features to modified files, components, and test coverage.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Text file containing short summaries of various frontend source files.
frontend/android-wrapper/.gitignore: Gitignore rules for Android wrapper build artifacts, IDE files, and temporary files.
frontend/android-wrapper/app/build.gradl: Gradle build configuration for the Android wrapper including base URL injection and build types.
frontend/android-wrapper/app/proguard-ru: ProGuard rules ensuring WebView functionality and preservation of wrapper classes.
frontend/android-wrapper/app/src/main/An: Android manifest declaring permissions, WebView activity, app metadata, and required features.
frontend/android-wrapper/app/src/main/ja: Main Android activity hosting the WebView with Internet Identity, camera permissions, and popup handling.
frontend/android-wrapper/app/src/main/re: Layout file defining a full‑screen WebView container.
String resources including the user-facing app name and injected base URL value.
Defines the app's Material theme and color palette.
Specifies files excluded from Android full-backup, mainly WebView data.
Defines cloud backup exclusions matching WebView-related files.
Enforces HTTPS-only connections and allows specific Internet Computer domains.
frontend/android-wrapper/build.gradle: Configures Android Gradle plugin, Kotlin plugin, and project-level repositories.
frontend/android-wrapper/gradle.properti: Sets Gradle performance options, AndroidX settings, and NutriScan base URL.
frontend/android-wrapper/gradle/wrapper/: Configures Gradle wrapper to use Gradle 8.2 with validation settings.
frontend/android-wrapper/README.md: Documentation for the Android WebView wrapper including setup and sideload build instructions.
frontend/android-wrapper/settings.gradle: Defines plugin management, repositories, and includes the app module.
frontend/index.css: Sets Tailwind base styles and light/dark theme CSS variables.
frontend/index.html: Basic HTML entry point loading the React app.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Configures router, authentication gate, and profile setup flow for the app.
frontend/src/components/auth/LoginButton: Login/logout button using Internet Identity with state-handling logic.
frontend/src/components/auth/ProfileSetu: Modal form for creating a complete user profile with validation and save calls.
frontend/src/components/camera/CapturedP: Displays a captured image with options to retake or proceed.
frontend/src/components/chat/ChatTranscr: Renders chat messages with auto-scroll, timestamps, and citation badges.
frontend/src/components/chat/SuggestedPr: Displays suggested questions that can be inserted into the chat.
frontend/src/components/dashboard/Mainte: Shows TDEE, today's calories, and status, with warnings if profile data is incomplete.
frontend/src/components/entries/DateRang: Provides previous/next buttons to shift a date range and displays the formatted start and end dates.
frontend/src/components/entries/EmptyEnt: Shows an illustration and message when no meal entries exist.
frontend/src/components/entries/EntryDet: Dialog displaying full details of a food entry with adjusted nutrition values and confidence indicators.
frontend/src/components/entries/Estimati: Handles confirming an image-based food estimation, adjusting nutrition, capturing notes via speech, and submitting a new entry.
frontend/src/components/entries/PortionC: Sliders for adjusting portion size and confidence level with optional guidance text.
frontend/src/components/entries/SimilarF: Shows alternative similar foods and lets the user select one as the final choice.
frontend/src/components/entries/TodayEnt: Lists today's food entries with quick calorie and confidence info and opens a detail dialog on click.
frontend/src/components/graphs/CaloriesO: Builds a line chart of daily calories over a selected date range and supports selecting a day.
frontend/src/components/graphs/MacroDist: Generates a pie chart summarizing total protein, carbs, and fat across provided entries.
frontend/src/components/graphs/Nutrition: Computes a nutrition balance score from food entries and displays grade, score, and explanation.
frontend/src/components/graphs/WeeklyRat: Renders a 1–10 rating scale with colored indicators and a star icon based on the score.
frontend/src/components/graphs/WeeklySum: Displays a weekly nutrition summary with rating, feedback, stats, macro totals, and suggestions.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppHeader: Renders the top navigation bar with branding, navigation buttons, and user login info.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppLayout: Provides the global app layout including header, footer, theming, and page container.
frontend/src/config/appBranding.ts: Defines centralized branding constants like app name, tagline, and description.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages the authenticated or anonymous backend actor and refreshes dependent queries on change.
frontend/src/hooks/useCallerHealthMetric: Fetches the current user's health metrics from the backend using the actor.
Loads suggested chat questions and provides a helper to find or fallback to an answer.
frontend/src/hooks/useCurrentUserProfile: Fetches and saves the caller's user profile via backend actor with react-query integration.
frontend/src/hooks/useFoodEntries.ts: Fetches food entries for a date range and provides a mutation to add new food entries.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides a React context and provider for Internet Identity authentication, handling login, stored identity loading, and status flags.
frontend/src/hooks/usePortionAdjusterGui: Fetches portion adjuster guidance text from the backend using react-query and the actor API.
frontend/src/hooks/useSpeechToText.ts: Implements a speech‑to‑text hook using the Web Speech API with transcript state, listening controls, and error handling.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind base styles and custom CSS variables for light and dark themes.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Renders the app root with React Query and Internet Identity providers applied.
frontend/src/pages/AddEntryPage.tsx: Page for manually adding a food entry with nutrition fields, portion adjustments, and form submission.
frontend/src/pages/CameraCapturePage.tsx: Camera capture workflow page enabling photo capture, preview, and estimation confirmation.
frontend/src/pages/DashboardPage.tsx: Dashboard showing today’s entries, summaries, charts, and user health metrics with date‑range selection.
frontend/src/pages/HelperChatPage.tsx: Implements a nutrition Q&A chat page with message handling, suggested prompts, and a simple knowledge‑base lookup.
frontend/src/pages/InstallAppPage.tsx: Displays Android app installation info with feature descriptions and step‑by‑step instructions.
frontend/src/pages/LoginPage.tsx: Renders the login screen using Internet Identity with branding and navigation to the install‑app page.
frontend/src/utils/localFoodDataset.ts: Provides a static nutrition dataset of foods with macros and keywords for lookup and matching.
frontend/src/utils/localNutritionEstimat: Implements simple food estimation, search, lookup, and nutrition‑per‑weight calculations using the local dataset.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading, persisting, and clearing URL and session parameters.
frontend/src/utils/weeklyFeedback.ts: Computes weekly nutrition totals, averages, macro percentages, and a heuristic score with feedback and suggestions based on logged food entries and optional body goals.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind with custom colors, fonts, animations, container settings, and plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Stores the project’s high-level state, features, requirements, architecture notes, and known issues for the diet‑tracking app.
